Adding technical context — thanks for the screenshot, Elena. This looks like a tenant-level calendar rewrite: FinOptima's calendar system is stripping the organizer and embedding the ICS as an opaque blob. If an attendee accepts that ICS it creates a local event with no organizer, which causes the "Unable to find organizer" error.

Options (ranked):
1) Recreate the event from a Redwood-managed mailbox (redwood-demo@redwood.com) and set the meeting as a Zoom meeting in the organizer's calendar. That produces a Meet/Zoom link that survives FinOptima's rewrite.
2) Send a one-click fallback Zoom link in the body of the email (what Neha suggested).
3) Create a public calendar shortlink (less preferred for security).

If you want me to reissue from an SE mailbox I can do that. Recommend we: (a) create the new event, (b) attach a short agenda, (c) send to Elena/Tom and ask them to delete the original invite to avoid duplicate RSVP confusion.
